subject: Request: Data mapping & SCC gap remediation for new analytics integrator
messages:
From: Eve Martinez <eve.martinez@logstream.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: compliance@logstream.io
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 13:13:00 +0200
Subject: New integrator: data mapping, SCC gaps + authorization needed

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are moving forward with a pilot to send pseudonymized event streams from EU tenants to LogStream's analytics pipeline. Before we flip the switch I need two things from Redwood for our compliance review: a) a dataflow export or mapping that shows what fields will be shared and whether any identifiers are included, and b) an SCC gap analysis that indicates any residual risks we should track (we run an internal CAIQ/SIG review as part of onboarding).

To proceed with the pilot we also need an explicit written authorization from Redwood that allows LogStream to process EU personal data as a subprocessor under the SCCs/DPA amendment (we've attached our onboarding checklist for reference). Can you confirm what evidence you can provide and whether Redwood can sign a limited addendum that authorizes the processing scope described below?

Scope summary we need covered: event ingestion (pseudonymized IDs), session timestamps, geo (country level only), and derived metrics. No raw PII (names/emails) will be shared.

Timeline: we'd like the mapping and SCC gap report within 5 business days if possible.

Attachments: onboarding-checklist-logstream-v1.pdf (sent)

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Best,
Eve Martinez
Security & Privacy
LogStream Inc.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eve Martinez <eve.martinez@logstream.io>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 07:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New integrator: data mapping, SCC gaps + authorization needed

Hi Eve — thanks for the clear summary and the checklist. Looping in Lauren (privacy counsel) and Marissa (security eng) to coordinate the deliverables and the DPA amendment.

Quick answers up front: we can produce a dataflow export and a preliminary SCC gap worksheet. We typically handle authorization via a scoped addendum to the DPA; I will share a draft and a DocuSign link once legal confirms the limited processing language.

Lauren / Marissa — can you confirm feasibility of delivering:
- Data mapping PDF showing fields, retention buckets, and pseudonymization status
- SCC gap worksheet with callbacks for any compensating controls
- Draft DPA addendum limited to the pilot scope (EU event pseudonymized ingestion)

Eve — if you can share any specific CAIQ or SIG questions you run regularly, attach them and we will weave answers into the SCC gap worksheet.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Eve Martinez <eve.martinez@logstream.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 15:02:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: New integrator: data mapping, SCC gaps + authorization needed

Hi Eve / team,

Thanks for the request — we can meet your 5 business day timeline for a preliminary package. We will produce the following deliverables:

1) Data mapping export (PDF) 
   - field-level descriptions, processing purpose, retention class, and pseudonymization status
   - highlighted fields that may require additional minimization for the pilot

2) SCC gap analysis (Excel)
   - row-level mapping to SCC clauses, current control references, and residual risk notes

3) DPA addendum (Word)
   - limited scope clause for the LogStream pilot (processing operations, data types, duration, subprocessors, deletion/return timeline)
   - termination and rollback language for pilot end-state

Please note: we will need a signed addendum before we commence sending EU tenant data. I will also attach a short DPIA template we can fill jointly if you prefer.

Attachments to follow from our side: dataflow-export-redwood-20270404.pdf, scc-gap-analysis-logstream-20270404.xlsx, dpa-amendment-draft-LogStream.docx

Questions for LogStream:
- Will LogStream act as a controller for any enrichment operations? If yes, please specify which datasets.
- Are you able to accept the standard SCCs without amendment or do you require controller-to-processor updates?

If helpful, Markus can do a quick sync (10–15 min) on the control table.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Privacy Counsel | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eve Martinez <eve.martinez@logstream.io>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 16:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New integrator: data mapping, SCC gaps + authorization needed

Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Eve: the three artifacts Lauren mentioned are uploaded to the Drive link below and I've kicked a DocuSign envelope for the limited DPA addendum. Please review the data mapping and SCC gap analysis; if it looks good, sign the addendum and we will schedule the pilot start.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cLogStream-DPA-evidence
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/LogStream_DPA_Addendum_202704

We will restrict the pilot to pseudonymized event streams and enforce retention limits as noted in the mapping. If LogStream needs any enrichment that would re-identify data, we will require an explicit change request and updated authorization.

Looking forward to the pilot — happy to set a 15-minute ops call next week to confirm the ingestion handshake.

Regards,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
